message.content: {"caption":"Diagram comparing sequential updates to a skill bank with hierarchical parallel merging of trace-derived patches into a distilled skill.","description":"The diagram has two panels separated by a vertical gray dashed line. On the left, “Traces Seq” lists pink boxes labeled Trace1, Trace2, Trace3, an ellipsis, and TraceN. An unlabeled black arrow points right from each shown trace to a blue box labeled respectively “Skill Bank v1,” “Skill Bank v2,” “Skill Bank v3,” and “Skill Bank vN.” Unlabeled blue arrows point downward between successive skill-bank versions, indicating sequential updates. Green circular crossed-tool icons appear beside the trace-to-bank updates. The panel is captioned “Sequential Updates of a Skill Bank.” On the right, “Traces Pool” appears above a red dashed enclosure containing pink boxes Trace1, Trace2, Trace3, an ellipsis, and TraceN. Beneath the pool, green circular crossed-tool icons are arranged in tiers: five across the top, three below, and one lower down. Unlabeled bracket-shaped connectors group patches into lower-tier patches, continuing downward to the final patch; a connector links that patch to the blue “Distilled Skill” box. The panel is captioned “Parallel Distillation of All Lessons into a Skill.” A legend identifies the green icon as “Skill Patch” and the bracket-shaped connector as “Patch Merge.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
